name: Willow and field crossing

layers.essential_history: [[c:The last stretch crosses a field with willow trees. We'll add a fact here after we've walked it again.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:The village board says the Nene Way crosses the water meadows towards Fotheringhay. This last stretch is on the edge of that river landscape, where willows like damp ground. That's our best guess, and we still need to check the exact route.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:Journal page: you're nearly back at the estate gate. You know most of the story now. Time to gather your evidence.]]

puzzle_note: [[c:No puzzle here. Have a think about what you've found.]]
directions_to_next: [[c:From the willow, head back towards the Red Lion for the big finish. It is roughly 300 metres to the south-east.]]
